source_hash_scope: Working-tree bytes of all files in the implementation commit, plus toolchain and dependency locks. Qualification records preserve development versus final-source scopes.

implementation.representation: CurrentImpulseDerivative(time, positive u32 order, finite nonzero coefficient) represents coefficient*delta^(order)(t-time), with coefficient units A*s^(order+1). Ordinary charge remains in CurrentImpulsePoint. Traces validate sorted unique (time,order) pairs and coverage of both lists.
implementation.periodic_math: Complex Fourier coefficients receive coefficient*(i*2*pi*f)^order*exp(-i*2*pi*f*(t-start))/duration. Binary mantissa/exponent products avoid intermediate overflow or underflow from compensating factors; exponentiation takes at most 32 iterations. Half-open (start,stop] ownership and DC zero are explicit.
implementation.routes: Public authored Fourier and rectangular FFT retain exact event time; result documents, compression, live samples, bounded live delivery, worker transfer, authenticated artifacts/digests and Python snapshots/pickles retain derivative order and coefficient.
implementation.versions: Result document version 10 accepts legacy versions 1-9 when they do not carry derivatives. Python current-impulse pickle version 3 decodes legacy version-1/version-2 state in the new implementation. Empty derivative lists preserve legacy digest bytes through conditional typed extensions.
implementation.accounting: Core results, worker limits and dependency artifact limits share numeric_value_count; derivative entries cost three scalar lanes. Live limits count charge and derivative entries together. Test payload-byte accounting includes two f64 fields and one u32 per derivative.
implementation.integration_repairs: Final review repaired Python cropping, worker/artifact accounting, the Python stub and old pickle-version tests. Derivative-only incomplete retained traces survive; past actions are not replayed.
implementation.runtime_admission: No physical event provider produces these higher derivatives yet. The descriptor transition kernel remains cfg(test), H-family physical-event admission remains absent, and checkpoint identity remains v105.

coverage.analytic_cases: Core Fourier checks five derivative orders, both coefficient signs, off-grid and stop-endpoint times, start-endpoint exclusion, affine weighting and complex phase at 2e-13 relative error. Rectangular FFT checks four orders and one-sided/Nyquist scaling. Range tests retain 1e300/1e-300 compensation and bound u32::MAX order evaluation.
coverage.transport_cases: Version gates, malformed order/coefficient/time/pair rejection, complete/incomplete coverage, compression/live preservation, bounded suffixes without replay, authenticated derivative tamper rejection, cropped-window retention, Python readonly snapshots and full/compressed pickle migrations.
coverage.scope: Selected native suites overlap; do not sum them as unique tests. Strict Clippy compiles/checks targets without executing all their tests. Two optimized WASM tests execute the public Fourier path. No public CCVS solve, voltage impulse, nonlinear GP coupling, full-suite or product-readiness claim.
